subject: Request: alternate billing channel for 3-month pilot (no PO)
body:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@vaultmetrics.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, May 8, 2027 at 4:23 PM -0400
Subject: Pilot onboarding — billing channel question (no PO)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week. We're ready to kick off a 3-month pilot with Redwood (roughly $18k estimated total across the period), but our procurement team is asking whether a PO is required for invoicing.

VaultMetrics currently issues invoices to vendors for trial engagements (we have internal constraints on PO creation for short engagements). To move quickly we'd prefer to receive monthly invoices without generating a PO on our side for this pilot. Happy to provide a statement of work and standard PO waiver form if you need it.

I've attached a brief pilot scope and our W-9. Let me know what info your finance/procurement team needs to approve an invoice-only path for this one-off pilot.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Partnerships
VaultMetrics
Attachments: VaultMetrics_W9.pdf, pilot-scope-vaultmetrics-2027-05.docx

----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@vaultmetrics.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, May 8, 2027 at 5:02 PM -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — billing channel question (no PO)

Hi Liam — great to hear, excited to get this moving.

Quick answer: Redwood's standard is PO-required for multi-month commitments, but we do have a temporary invoice-only corridor for low-risk pilots under $25k with a few controls. To evaluate we need:
- a signed SOW or pilot scope (you attached the scope — thanks)
- W-9 (received)
- payment owner + email for remittance
- proof of corporate registration (if available)

Jonas and Priya — looping you in to confirm risk tier and whether we can approve a 3-month invoice-only path for deal VM-PLT-2027-04.

If procurement needs a written exception, we can issue a one-time "pilot billing exception" letter that limits exposure and requires invoicing on a monthly cadence. I can also share our billing-evidence checklist.

Next step for Liam: can you share the billing contact and whether VaultMetrics will require any contract redlines?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

----
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam@vaultmetrics.io>
Date: Sat, May 9, 2027 at 09:41 AM -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — billing channel question (no PO)

Thanks for the context. I've reviewed VaultMetrics' intake. Initial risk assessment: low (SMB SaaS, public company registration, referenceable). Proposed guardrails for invoice-only pilot:

1) Pilot limited to 3 months, monthly invoices net30.
2) Total not to exceed $25k; any overage requires PO or contract amendment.
3) Redwood retains right to pause service if invoices are >45 days outstanding.
4) VaultMetrics signs a simple Pilot Billing Exception Letter and our standard SOW.

Priya — can finance accept monthly invoices without a PO for this record? If not, what's the quickest path (short-term PO, temporary internal waiver)?

Liam — I'll draft the exception letter and attach the billing-evidence checklist (see attached).

Jonas Weber
Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference
Attachment: billing-evidence-checklist.xlsx

----
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam@vaultmetrics.io>
Date: Sat, May 9, 2027 at 10:35 AM -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — billing channel question (no PO)

Jonas / Marissa — finance is OK to process monthly invoices for a defined pilot under these controls. Requirements from finance side:
- Invoices must reference SOW id and deal id (VM-PLT-2027-04)
- Include remittance contact: billing@vaultmetrics.io or a named contact
- VaultMetrics must provide W-9 and any tax forms for our records (we have VaultMetrics_W9.pdf already)
- One-time internal memo filed to record exception (I will create this).

If contract/legal has no material redlines (standard SOW), I approve moving forward. Please ensure the exception letter includes the end date and overage clause.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

----
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam@vaultmetrics.io>
Date: Mon, May 10, 2027 at 11:12 AM -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — billing channel question (no PO)

All — I've reviewed the proposal and approve a one-time pilot billing exception under the guardrails Jonas outlined. Conditions:
- Exception valid from May 10, 2027 through Aug 9, 2027 (3 months).
- Invoices monthly, net30, and must reference deal VM-PLT-2027-04.
- Total capped at $25k; any additional spend requires a PO or updated SOW.
- VaultMetrics signs the Pilot Billing Exception Letter (I will sign on behalf of Redwood).

Marissa — please send the exception letter and SOW to Liam and request billing contact for remittance. Priya will file the internal memo.

Liam — welcome aboard, looking forward to the pilot.

Best,
Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

----
Attachments referenced in thread: VaultMetrics_W9.pdf; pilot-scope-vaultmetrics-2027-05.docx; billing-evidence-checklist.xlsx

Related links: https://drive.redwood.com/s/VM-pilot-contract-draft (contract draft), HubSpot HS-12345

Next steps summary (from Marissa):
- Marissa to send Pilot Billing Exception Letter and SOW to VaultMetrics by end of day May 10.
- VaultMetrics to confirm billing contact and sign exception letter.
- Finance (Priya) to file internal memo and accept monthly invoices net30.
- Procurement (Jonas) will monitor compliance and pause service on overdue invoices per clause.

"This thread resides in mailbox: marissa_cole"
"End of thread"
